title: Fatty liver: follow-up with a liver specialist
what: This is when extra fat builds up in the liver. The doctor keeps watch so the liver is not damaged and helps you turn it around.
why: If ultrasound showed fat in the liver, liver tests are raised, or you have extra weight, diabetes, or high cholesterol.
duration: a visit usually takes 20 to 30 minutes, and follow-up lasts months to years
tell_doctor: How much and how often you drink alcohol, honestly
Which medicines and supplements you take
Whether you have diabetes, high blood pressure, or high cholesterol
How your weight changed over the last years

prepare.title: Tests
prepare.text: The doctor may ask for liver tests, sugar, and cholesterol. Usually on an empty stomach.

prepare.title: Exams
prepare.text: Bring your previous liver ultrasounds and tests, so the doctor can see how things change.

prepare.title: Diary
prepare.text: You can write down what you eat in a normal week.

bring: A list of medicines and supplements
steps: The doctor asks about diet, alcohol, and illnesses
Looks at your tests and ultrasound
Sometimes sends you for a liver stiffness scan
Makes a plan for diet, activity, and follow-up
feel: Having the belly felt may be a little unpleasant
after: The main treatment is gradual weight loss and activity
Your doctor will usually advise limiting or cutting out alcohol
Tests and ultrasound follow-ups are on the schedule your doctor sets
red_flags: Yellow skin or eyes, vomiting blood, or black stools: call emergency services
Severe pain in the right side or a swelling belly: see a doctor urgently

faq.a: Often yes. With weight loss, the fat in the liver goes down.
Your doctor decides. The basis of treatment is diet, activity, and weight.

reminders.text: Liver specialist visit tomorrow. Bring your past liver ultrasounds and tests.
